page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor, which operates at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The absence of local NVMe drives and graphics accelerators represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing memory density and dedicated compute resources over local I/O speed and parallel processing hardware.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes this instance profile suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local disk caching or GPU acceleration. It is designed for applications such as in-memory databases, large-scale enterprise applications, caching layers, and memory-bound data processing tasks where dedicated CPU allocation and high RAM capacity are critical.
